task: EN->KO translation of SAGE-v2 questions, read-backs and messages (AssistLoop._in_lang prompt)
prompt: Translate into natural spoken Korean. Keep it short and polite. Output only the translation:\n{text}

items.source: distinct English texts SAGE-v2 sent to translation in earlier KO runs (llm caches of results/live_smoke, pilot_r27*, gate30_r27)

scores.method: 3 independent blind judge agents (judge_{1,2,3}.json; per-item random order, model names hidden); per item: mean of the 3 judges for meaning / natural (1-5), majority for names_kept / cjk_or_garble; then mean / rate over the 330 items

mismatch_rate.method: homeloop_robot SimUser._content on each model's Korean, in the episode of the task the text came from (profile ideal, seed 0, lang ko; task found by matching the run's Korean in the run's episodes); reference = derive() of the English (structured meaning) when a template matches, else the simulator's reading of the English text; mismatch = path structured_mismatch (structured) or a different qtype / not in Korean (English reading); classifier fallback qwen3-vl:8b-instruct, cached in user_intent_cache.jsonl
mismatch_rate.note: 27 items mismatch for all three models: the English itself carries raw ids, Korean fragments or wrong names (e.g. 'the 우유 from the fridge', 'in the grandpa'); those are SAGE weaknesses (Round 3 item 6), not translation errors

qwen3-vl:30b-a3b-instruct.note: step-1 run had about 2.9 GB of the weights on the CPU (three models loaded); the latency above is pessimistic

full_gpu_recheck.note: loaded next to the 8B planner only (OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=8, num_ctx 8192): 100 % on GPU 0; 19 of 42 outputs differ in wording from step 1 (CPU/GPU split changes the numerics); the scores are on the step-1 outputs

memory.note: 8B planner + 30B translator use 36.8 GB of GPU 0 including other users' processes, under the 40 GB cap with about 3 GB headroom at OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=8; 8B + EXAONE would be about 29.9 GB. The tighter fit counts against the 30B: check nvidia-smi before raising parallel slots

choice_reason: best on all three criteria: meaning 4.42 vs 4.00 (EXAONE) and 3.86 (8B), paired sign test vs EXAONE p=4.2e-12; names kept 0.870 vs 0.858 / 0.782; no garble 0.994 vs 0.970 / 0.909; lowest heard-text mismatch 0.236 vs 0.279 / 0.279; Apache-2.0. Costs: higher latency (0.34 s mean on full GPU vs 0.27 s EXAONE) and 6 GB more GPU memory than EXAONE
licence_note: qwen3-vl:30b-a3b-instruct and qwen3-vl:8b-instruct: Apache-2.0 (licence text in the model's ollama manifest), fine for the public release. exaone3.5: EXAONE AI Model License Agreement 1.1 - NC (non-commercial; research use at runtime only) - not chosen. The translator is a runtime dependency; the bench ships no model weights.
